cards.title: Pen + close + finish
cards.test: Three hardware clicks add 3 nodes; click first point sets closed[0]=true; Esc finishes.

cards.title: V path select / A direct select
cards.test: selectPath → showingNodes false; selectPoint → showingNodes true and selected set.

cards.title: Deselect hides anchors
cards.why: Anchors are edit chrome, not the drawing.
cards.test: Click empty world point: showingNodes false. Ctrl+H toggles hideNodes.

cards.title: Small constant-size anchors
cards.test: getState().anchorSize ≤ 3 (half-size px) at 100% and at 200% zoom.

cards.title: Zoom + pan camera
cards.why: Artboard is not 1:1 with the window.
cards.test: zoomAt(x,y,2) doubles camera.scale; Ctrl+wheel increases scale; fitArtboard scale > 0.05.

cards.title: Ellipse (L) + rectangle (M)
cards.test: Drag ellipse/rect; pathCount +1; path.closed true; 4 anchors on each.

cards.title: Per-path stroke/fill + layers
cards.test: Change stroke on selected path; serializeOutline paths[i].stroke matches; layer eye toggles visible.

cards.title: Undo, clipboard, SVG, outline JSON
cards.test: Copy writes <svg>; paste pathCount +1; Export downloads .svg; Save downloads draw-outline-v2 JSON; loadOutline restores nodeCount.

cards.title: Pen rubber-band preview
cards.why: You should see the next segment before the click.
cards.test: In pen mode with ≥1 point, mousemove (no down) draws a preview segment to the cursor; click commits; Esc cancels preview without adding a node.

cards.title: Click segment to insert anchor
cards.test: A-mode click on a stroke (not an anchor): nodeCount +1; new point lies on the segment; path stays closed if it was.
cards.notes: Shipped 2026-09-01. A-mode stroke click inserts a point on the cubic; closed stays closed; anchor click does not insert.

cards.title: Convert corner ↔ smooth
cards.test: Double-click corner → hasHandles true with mirrored cp; Alt-drag one handle breaks the pair (cp1/cp2 independent); double-click smooth retracts handles.
cards.notes: Shipped 2026-09-01. A/pen dblclick toggles corner↔smooth; Alt-drag breaks the pair.

cards.title: Arrow-key nudge
cards.test: Direct-select a point; ArrowRight moves x by 1; Shift+ArrowRight by 10; V-select path nudges every point.
cards.notes: Shipped 2026-09-01. Arrow keys nudge 1px (Shift=10). A-mode moves the selected point; V-mode moves every point on the path.

cards.title: Marquee-select points
cards.test: A-mode drag empty: rectangle; points inside become selected; drag moves all of them; nodeCount unchanged.
cards.notes: Shipped 2026-09-01. A-mode empty drag marquees points; drag a selected point moves the set; click empty deselects.

cards.title: Scale / rotate from bbox
cards.why: V-select needs transform, not just move.
cards.test: V-select path; drag a corner handle changes bounds W/H; drag rotate handle changes point angles; undo restores original points.
cards.notes: Shipped 2026-09-01. V-select corner/edge scale + top rotate handle; undo restores points.

cards.title: Align / distribute
cards.test: Select two paths; Align Left sets both minX equal; Distribute H spaces midpoints evenly (±1px).
cards.notes: Shipped 2026-09-03. Shift-click multi-select; Align against union bbox; Distribute H/V spaces centers between outermost selected.

cards.title: Duplicate + Select All
cards.test: Ctrl+A selects every live path; Ctrl+D clones selected with offset, pathCount +1, clone is selected.
cards.notes: Shipped 2026-09-03. Ctrl+A selects every live path; Ctrl+D clones selection offset 24,24 and selects the clones.

cards.title: Hex + numeric weight in inspector
cards.why: Color input alone is not precise.
cards.test: Type #FF00AA into stroke hex; selectedPath.stroke === "#ff00aa" (case-insensitive); numeric weight 0.5–16 updates strokeWidth.
cards.notes: Shipped 2026-09-03. Stroke/fill hex fields; numeric weight 0.5–16; picker/slider stay in sync.

cards.title: Caps, joins, dash
cards.test: Set cap=square, join=miter, dash=4 2; SVG export attributes match; canvas stroke uses them.
cards.notes: Shipped 2026-09-03. Cap/Join/Dash on inspector, canvas, and SVG export.

cards.title: Gradient fill
cards.why: Flat fill is not enough for finished work.
cards.test: Enable linear gradient on a closed path; SVG has <linearGradient> + fill=url(); serialize stores stops.
cards.notes: Shipped 2026-09-03. Linear gradient fill: inspector stops, canvas paint, SVG linearGradient + fill=url(), serialize stores stops.

cards.title: Eyedropper
cards.test: I-tool click a path copies stroke/fill/weight onto the next selected path; inspector fields update.
cards.notes: Shipped 2026-09-03. I-tool samples appearance; applies to current selection or the next selected path; inspector updates.

cards.title: Rename + lock layers
cards.why: Layer list is currently display-only names.
cards.test: Double-click layer name edits path.name; lock prevents move/delete; locked path ignores pointer hit.
cards.notes: Shipped 2026-09-03. Double-click layer name to rename. Lock skips pointer hit, move, and delete.

cards.title: Z-order forward / back
cards.why: Draw order is the only stacking today.
cards.test: Bring forward swaps index with next; hit-test prefers the top path; serialize order matches draw order.
cards.notes: Shipped 2026-09-03. Bring forward swaps with next; hit-test prefers the top path; serialize order matches draw order.

cards.title: Group / ungroup
cards.test: Group two paths; V-drag moves both; ungroup restores two selectable paths; nodeCount unchanged.
cards.notes: Shipped 2026-09-03. Ctrl+G groups; V-select/drag moves all members; ungroup restores independent paths; nodeCount unchanged.

cards.title: Paste in place / in front
cards.why: Offset paste is wrong for alignment work.
cards.test: Copy; Paste in place: clone x/y equal original; Paste in front: clone is top of hit-test.
cards.notes: Shipped 2026-09-03. Paste in place keeps x/y; paste in front is top of hit-test.

cards.title: Rulers + guides
cards.test: Drag from ruler creates a guide; guide is visible at all zooms; delete guide removes it from serialize.
cards.notes: Shipped 2026-09-06. Drag top/left rulers to create guides; drag to move; Delete or drag outside to remove. Undo/redo, JSON open/save and session restore verified in Chromium; visible at 5%–6400% zoom.

cards.title: Snap to grid / points / guides
cards.test: With snap on, drop an anchor within 6px of a grid line; stored x equals the grid; toggle off stores free x.
cards.notes: Shipped 2026-09-06. Inspector snapping toggle (off by default, remembered). Six screen-pixel tolerance for visible grid, anchor points and guides. Pen/shape placement and anchor/path translation snap; moving anchors are excluded and path geometry is preserved. Visible grid spacing follows zoom; hiding the grid disables grid targets. Chromium verified on/off coordinates, guides/points, hidden target exclusion, zoom tolerance, undo/redo, pen/rectangle creation, rigid path movement and reload; rulers regression passed.

cards.title: Zoom to selection
cards.why: Ctrl+0 fits the board, not the work.
cards.test: Select a path; zoom-to-selection puts its bounds in view with padding; camera.scale changes.
cards.notes: Shipped 2026-09-06. View > Zoom to Selection / Ctrl+2 frames selected paths with 48px padding beyond the rulers. Includes Bezier control points and stroke width; supports multiple paths, lines and a single anchor. Empty selection leaves camera unchanged. Chromium verified menu/keyboard framing and finite camera state.

cards.title: Numeric X/Y for selected anchor
cards.test: Direct-select a point; type X=400; selected.x === 400; undo restores previous x.
cards.notes: Shipped 2026-09-06. Transform inspector Anchor X/Y fields edit one unlocked direct-selected anchor. Enter or blur commits; Escape cancels. Exact finite coordinates bypass snapping, translate both handles, preserve other anchors, and support undo/redo and session persistence. Chromium verified X=400, negative/decimal Y, invalid input and locked-anchor protection.

cards.title: Pencil freehand
cards.test: Drag pencil; mouseup creates a simplified path with ≥2 points; undo removes it.
cards.notes: Shipped 2026-09-07. Pencil (N) with live preview, screen-space simplification and editable anchors. Release commits one path and one undo step; clicks, Escape, pointer cancellation and tool switching discard drafts. Chromium: 101 samples simplified to 11 anchors; undo/redo, straight lines and session reload passed.

cards.title: Boolean / pathfinder
cards.test: Two overlapping closed paths; Unite → 1 closed path; nodeCount of result ≥ 3; original two gone.
cards.notes: Shipped 2026-09-07. Path menu and inspector Unite/Subtract Front for selected unlocked closed shapes. Backmost appearance and stack position retained. Cubic-preserving Paper.js engine is vendored for offline use. Compound holes/islands stay one editable path through direct edits, segment insertion, transforms, SVG/JSON, clipboard, undo/redo and reload. Chromium verified exact rectangle areas, transparent holes, curved shapes, disjoint/touching/identical inputs, multiple cutters, empty subtraction and atomic failure. Tests: tests/pathfinder.py; precision, snapping, pencil and offline Entity regressions passed.

cards.title: Multiple artboards
cards.why: One 800×600 board will not stay enough.
cards.test: Add artboard; serialize artboards.length +1; export can target the active board bounds.
cards.notes: Shipped 2026-09-07. Artboards inspector: add/select/name/position/resize/remove, Fit active and Fit all. Shared world-coordinate artwork stays unchanged when boards change. SVG area selector exports exact active bounds with clipping or all artwork. Outline v4 saves boards and active ID, including empty documents; legacy single boards migrate. Undo/redo, SVG download pixels, blank save/open/reload, removal preserving paths and Entity insertion on the active board passed Chromium. Precision, snapping, Pencil, Pathfinder, rulers and offline Entity regressions passed. Details: planning/artboards.md.

cards.title: PNG export
cards.why: SVG is not always the handoff.
cards.test: Export PNG downloads image/png; pixel size matches artboard * scale factor.
cards.notes: Shipped 2026-09-07. File menu and Output panel PNG export uses selected Active artboard or All artwork area with 1x–4x scale and transparent background. Real image/png downloads verified at 1x, 2x and 4x for exact dimensions, gold pixels and transparency; blank export, area selection, encoding failure recovery and size limits passed. Artboards, Pathfinder, Pencil, precision, snapping, rulers and offline Entity regressions passed. Details: planning/png-svg-drop.md.

cards.title: Drag-drop SVG import
cards.why: Open is a file picker today.
cards.test: Drop an .svg onto the viewport; pathCount increases; paste parser handles the markup.
cards.notes: Shipped 2026-09-07. Drop one or multiple SVG files onto the viewport to add editable paths at the drop position with one-step undo. Shared Paste/Open parser handles basic shapes, curves/arcs, transforms, compound contours and opaque linear gradients. Drag feedback, undo/redo, reload, multi-file atomicity, malformed/unsupported files, failed reads and document changes during reads verified. No external requests or browser errors. Details: planning/png-svg-drop.md.

cards.title: Entity Harness LLM panel: prompt, preview, insert
cards.why: Re-implement the resident model panel in the right scrollable inspector so users can create vector images from prompts.
cards.test: Connect to a configured Entity Harness model; submit a prompt and render returned vector artwork in a separate preview without changing the document. Copy exports the preview vector source; Paste accepts vector source into the preview; Insert adds editable paths to the document and one Undo removes that insertion. Loading, connection failures, and invalid output show clear status without changing existing artwork.
cards.notes: Re-queued 2026-09-06 at user request. Include prompt input, dedicated preview, and Copy/Paste/Insert actions in the right scrollable pane. Original LLM integration could not be located; the older Path Synthesizer is only a local geometry generator. Harness address/port is unknown: establish a configurable connection during implementation. Verify a real model round trip, not just a mocked response.

cards.title: apple pencil ui + support gen 2 upwards
cards.test: User manually tests on an M1 iPad with a generation 2 Apple Pencil: drawing, selection, editing and tool controls are usable with Pencil; interaction-strength settings produce an observable change and retain their values after reload. Check battery observation if the platform exposes it; otherwise clearly record it as unavailable.
cards.notes: Implemented 2026-09-07. Pencil & touch inspector: persistent freehand base width, pressure strength, smoothing, and Pencil selection reach. Finger input defaults to ignore for palm protection; optional pan or current tool. Single-pointer ownership keeps other touches from changing active strokes. Larger tablet controls, on-canvas Undo/Redo/Finish, collapsible inspector. Pressure controls uniform whole-stroke width from average pressure; existing editable paths and exports retained. Battery observation and barrel gestures unavailable in this web implementation. Automated Chromium outcomes verified; User hardware verification passed on M1 iPad with Apple Pencil generation 2. Later Pencil models not hardware verified. See planning/apple-pencil.md. User reports all tested features working except the Pencil eraser end; explicitly accepted as-is, with no implementation requested. Brushes and an eraser tool are possible future ideas, not committed scope.

cards.title: text support and font picker
cards.test: type a word in blender font or any font
cards.notes: User verified text and font picker working. Bundled fonts plus TTF/OTF/WOFF loading, portable outlines and retained editing recipes. See planning/text-panels.md.

cards.title: re-order tool windows
cards.test: re-order a tool like a widget, collapse tool window and re-open, detach tool window then snap back to side-pane. minimise a tool window. add tools drop down to top bar to show hide tools from the side-pane.
cards.notes: User verified panel controls working and confirmed the Attach/Detach label fix. Hover title and accessibility label now switch together; opposite arrow states verified. See planning/text-panels.md.

cards.title: local updater - patch handler
cards.test: a local smoke test. with later actual usage test.
cards.notes: Built local updater using a Vercel HTTPS manifest and ZIP, independent of Git. Windows launcher and Python CLI, checksums, pre-update backups, rollback, interrupted-update recovery and local-edit protection. Twelve local failure/smoke tests plus packaged-editor browser smoke passed. Actual user installation test pending. See planning/local-updater.md.

cards.title: add light dark theme switcher and add branding
cards.test: user tests theme switcher
cards.notes: Built 2026-09-08. OPEN-VECTOR title and supplied Open-Vector.png logo, embedded for offline/package portability. Persistent light/dark theme button updates interface, canvas board, rulers, grid and selection chrome without changing artwork, SVG exports or Undo history. Small footer credit: miniscule solutions 2026. Chromium theme/reload/artwork preservation and tablet layout checks passed. User verified theme switching and approved branding on 2026-09-08.

cards.title: Update Buttons and Aesthetics
cards.test: button tests, and visual checks
cards.notes: Built 2026-10-11 (awaiting user check). New Open-Vector.png logo embedded (transparent padding trimmed, image otherwise unchanged); redundant OPEN-VECTOR header text removed since the logo now carries it. Menus left-aligned beside the logo at the very top of the header; an empty #contextBar slot sits under them for future context-aware widgets. Zoom box collapses to a magnifier: hover expands, tap/click pins open, and it flashes the zoom % for 1.2s on any zoom change. Coordinates box has a crosshair hide/show button, remembered across reloads. Undo, Redo, Finish, Inspector and the theme switch are now 36px icon buttons with hover titles (shortcuts included); Inspector title follows state. Delete tool gained an accessible label. Tests: tests/buttons_aesthetics.py; theme, pencil, precision, snapping, rulers, text-panels, artboards, release smoke pass. Screenshot: planning/buttons-tablet.png. Beauty pass 2026-10-11: panel controls are drawn line icons (chevrons, arrows, pop-out/dock, minimise, close) with unchanged labels; decorative VECTOR STUDIO header label removed; toolbar tools show only the styled tip (duplicate native tooltip removed, tip also on keyboard focus); viewport controls get a soft shadow and a stronger light-theme border. Panel controls now share the title row and fade in on panel hover/focus (mouse/trackpad); touch keeps the always-visible row.
